meta.methodology: Read framework.md, torah_59_packages.json, all reference===59 edges from torahData.js (19 total edges: 13 bechina, 6 eitza), and the full source text torah_59.txt. For each bechina statement in the source text, verified whether the concept appears as a node in the dataset with a bechina edge for reference===59. Only concepts with explicit bechina language (בְּחִינַת, הַיְנוּ, נִקְרָא, בְּחִינָה אַחַת) were considered for addition. Pure eitza statements, proof-text citations, and positional/locational claims were excluded.

This is an explicit bechina statement using 'הַיְנוּ' and 'זֶה' formulas: the letter מ"ם IS the ריבועא (square), just as the letter סמ"ך is the עיגולא (circle). The אות מ"ם is not in the dataset as a bechina node for Torah #59. Since ריבועא = משפט and יד = ריבועא are already captured (edges 1992 and 2658), the missing link is the letter מ"ם as the square-letter that parallels the circle-letter סמ"ך. The bechina מם ↔ ריבועא is the exact mirror of the captured בchina עגול ↔ אות סמ"ך (edge 197). Both should be in the dataset. The source also implies מם ↔ כסאות למשפט (= כסא כבוד domain). Suggested new edge: אות מ"ם ↔ רבוע, reference=59, type=bechina.

additions.reason: Section ה (line 22): 'הַשֵּׁם הוּא הַנֶּפֶשׁ, בִּבְחִינַת (בְּרֵאשִׁית ב): נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה הוּא שְׁמוֹ'. The נפש bechina belongs in Package 3 because it is the soul-dimension of the חומה/עשירות domain (the wall protects the soul-name, and all souls have their root in wealth). Note: this bechina also links שם (Pkg 1) to נפש (Pkg 3) — שם is the bridge node between packages. Suggested new edge: שם ↔ נפש, reference=59, type=bechina.

concepts_examined_and_excluded.reason: Section א-ג uses 'הֵיכָל' extensively as both the object being built and as a bechina of כָּבוֹד ('הַכָּבוֹד זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת הֵיכָל'). However, the reverse (כבוד = היכל) is explicitly in the text and flagged under the 'כבוד' addition above. Adding both 'היכל' and 'כבוד' separately would create a pair. Since 'כבוד' is more conceptually active in the teaching (it is described as the substance of the Throne: 'כִּסֵּא כָּבוֹד') while 'היכל' is more the structural form, and the dominant bechina for the Temple-concept in this Torah is expressed through the עיגולא-כסא cluster, the 'כבוד' addition captures the essential gap. If adding 'כבוד ↔ כסא כבוד', one could also add 'היכל ↔ כבוד' as a second bechina edge. Suggested but not listed separately to avoid duplication — the 'כבוד' node addition effectively bridges this.

Section ב (line 12): 'קִרְיָה זֶה בְּחִינַת יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר הַקֹּדֶשׁ' and section ב cites Jeremiah 3:17 'בָּעֵת הַהִיא יִקְרְאוּ לִירוּשָׁלַיִם כִּסֵּא ה''. Jerusalem is explicitly named as a bechina of the Holy City AND of כסא ה'. This is a strong bechina statement. However, ירושלים here is used primarily as a proof-text location (the verse from Isaiah identifying Jerusalem = קרייה = faithful city) and as the Throne-city. The bechina of ירושלים = כסא is a verse-citation (Jeremiah), not a new independent declaration from the Rebbe. The כסא כבוד is already captured in the dataset. Marginal case — excluded from definitive additions but flagged as a candidate.

Section א (line 8): 'וְאָז גַּם הֵיכַל הַקֹּדֶשׁ מְקַבֵּל כֹּחַ הָאֵשׁ... בִּבְחִינַת (שמות כד): וּכְבוֹד ה' כְּאֵשׁ אֹכֶלֶת'. This verse equates כבוד with אש. However, the Rebbe cites it as a proof-text supporting the mechanism (fire burns the klipot), not as a new bechina declaration. The אש here is the fire that the angels produce (= Package 2) and that burns away the impure. The אש ↔ כבוד equivalence comes from the verse, not from the Rebbe's own bechina statement. Excluded per strict methodology.

Section א (line 5): 'הָרוּחַ הוּא בַּלֵּב, בִּבְחִינַת: וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם לֵב חָדָשׁ וְרוּחַ חֲדָשָׁה'. The location 'the ruach is in the heart' is stated, and the verse identifies lev and ruach as paired. But 'הוּא בַּלֵּב' is a positional claim (the ruach RESIDES in the heart), not a bechina equation (ruach IS the heart). The connection is structural/locational. Excluded.

Section ה (line 21): 'כִּי מַעְיַן הַחָכְמָה יוֹצֵא מִבֵּית ה'' and 'בְּחָכְמָה יִבָּנֶה בָּיִת'. The 'בית ה'' is used as a proof-text supporting the eitza chain (wisdom flows from the House of God). The phrase 'בחכמה יבנה בית' is a verse citation, not a Rebbe-declared bechina for Torah #59. Excluded.

Section ה (line 26): 'כִּי הַכַּעַס פּוֹגֵם בְּנַפְשׁוֹ, בִּבְחִינַת (אִיּוֹב יח): טוֹרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ בְּאַפּוֹ'. This is a causal statement (anger damages the soul) supported by a verse, not a bechina (anger IS the soul). The connection between כעס and נפש here is eitza (cause: anger; effect: soul damage). Excluded.

Section ו (line 37): 'וְעַל הַנֶּפֶשׁ נֶאֱמַר (קהלת ו): טוֹב מַרְאֵה עֵינַיִם מֵהֲלָךְ נָפֶשׁ'. The verse from Kohelet uses 'עינים' as a metaphor for seeing over 'wandering of the soul'. The Rebbe uses this verse to connect the eye-concept to the soul-concept. However, the formula is 'נֶאֱמַר' (it is said), not 'הַיְנוּ' or 'זֶה בְּחִינַת'. It reads more like a verse-citation illustration than a direct bechina declaration from the Rebbe. The connection נפש ↔ שם (which IS a direct Rebbe-declaration) is captured in the 'נפש' addition above. Not listed separately.
